description: One end of a relationship in application terms. A route vertex carries `routeId` and its `endpointId`; a group-route vertex carries `groupRouteId` and its canonical `groupId` (after following merges).

routeId.description: The Port OS route ID, for a route vertex.

endpointId.description: The endpoint the route belongs to, for a route vertex.

groupRouteId.description: The Port OS group route ID, for a group-route vertex.

groupId.description: The canonical endpoint group the group route belongs to, for a group-route vertex.
